events.name: Thursday Night Fights:Boxing
events.info: Boxing matches and MMA fights consist of three, minute and a half rounds with minute and a half rest periods. Every fighter gets a chance to win money; win or lose! The season typically starts off in October and continues through the long cold winters to end in April. Doors are at 6:30pm. Event starts at 7:30. All ages are welcome in our Dry section. Anyone under 18 *must* be with a parent or guardian. Our wet sections are 21+ with valid ID. The Egan Center is a Cashless facility. No Cash is accepted at the bars or box office. *No re-entry allowed. No guns or knives allowed. *
events.pleaseNote: No re-entry. The Egan Center is a cashless facility. No guns or knives permitted.

ticketLimit.info: Please note: There is a ticket limit of 10 tickets per person and per credit card on this event.
